Principle 5 : Getting ready for school/At school
Getting ready for school is the hardest part of my day.
I am often late for school because I sleep-in late,
and my mornings are very busy.
My family is so busy; we can’t even eat breakfast together.
Before I go to school, my mother gives me my allowance.
My school is near my house.
It usually takes me 15 minutes to walk to school.
Sometimes in the spring and the fall, I ride my bike to school.
I can get to school more quickly by bicycle than I can on foot.
It takes me under 10 minutes by bike.
On my way to school, I stop by the stationary store
and go in to buy the supplies I need for class.
As I am walking to school,I often see my friends,
so we walk to school together.
At 8:30 in the morning,
we meet before class with our teacher for morning session.
During this time, our teacher calls roll
and gives us the announcements for the day.
While the teacher is conducting the morning session,
the students are very noisy so the teacher has to shout at us
to get us to quiet down.
When class starts at 9:00, our teacher checks our homework
and our journals that we put on his desk.
When I don’t do my homework, I get so nervous
and feel like I have butterflies in my stomach.
Sometimes I hide my hands under my desk
because I am afraid of what my teacher will say.
Like most other students, my favorite subject is P.E.,
and the class I dislike the most is history.
Usually in class, the students are very friendly to each other.
However, sometimes there can be fights and arguments between
classmates. Most of the students quickly make up and are friends again.
Because our class has a lot of smart students in it,
we are very competitive.
At school, I like to study and make friends.
